strategies.name: currency_momentum_factor
strategies.why_it_failed: Scored PF 0.89 / Sharpe -0.42 over 300 trades -- but that verdict is on a mutilated version. Its headline mechanism is a cross-pair ranking, and the harness passes one pair at a time with no pair identity, so the rank filter was unreachable and the module degenerated to absolute momentum.
strategies.next_step: Five currencies leave four active legs (net_tercile_weights sends the median to 0.0) and the published effect is a breadth effect. Needs a wider universe to be a fair test.
